text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I apologize for incurring such an injury...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, it is not severe enough to
warrant
changes to the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With a little time to rest, I should be
able to
resume training as planned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With a little time to rest, I should be
able to
resume training as planned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, we'll end up delaying the
schedule,
though...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Apologies. The pressure seems to be
getting to
me. I will focus on recovery
for now...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I just hope we can get back on track
afterwards...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Light running should not be an
issue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That was more painful than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I must practice more, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I warn Eishin Flash not to push herself
and give
her a time-out to recover.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, this level of discomfort seems
manageable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's create a new schedule that
accommodates
for my injury right away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And like that, we get Eishin Flash back
on a
training regimen that isn't too
strenuous.
